attributes.check1: Stealth or Arcane or Wisdom or Diplomacy 20
attributes.name: Sweetlips and Scurvy
attributes.powers:
If undefeated, Sweetlips and Scurvy does not deal damage; instead, banish a random card from your discard pile. Then add a random monster to a random open location.

We'll play a mournful dirge when you dance your last jig from the yardarm. Right, Scurvy?
